title: PERS Pendant Test-Call Freshness
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:pendant device_id=* last_test_epoch=* snapshot_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((snapshot_epoch-last_test_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by device_id
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures test-call freshness by device for pendant readiness.
value: Lag tracking shows which device create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside pendant readiness.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `test-call freshness` on `care:pendant` events and aggregate them by `device_id`.
visualization: Table of device with average and worst test-call freshness.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how long things take for each device so you can see where pendant readiness slows down.
